name: Shenzhen Highpower Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Highpower Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of lithium-ion and nickel-metal hydride (Ni-MH) batteries in China and internationally. The company provides lithium and nickel-metal hydride batteries, battery systems, and energy storage battery solutions, as well as battery recycling and re-utilization services.
